project: عزم · AZM — offline Arabic/English fitness coach (bodyweight + gym), single HTML file

run.open: Double-click dist/military_calisthenics_coach_v5.html (Chrome/Edge). No server, no internet needed.
run.a11y: AXE=/path/axe.min.js NODE_PATH=$(npm root -g) node tests/a11y.cjs tests/evidence/export_full.json

hardConstraints: No network calls, CDNs, analytics or external fonts at runtime (CSP connect-src none). Only user-clicked YouTube search links are external.
Red-flag screening must block plan generation; never add a bypass.
Edit src/ and rebuild; dist is generated.
Do not claim tests/devices/sources that were not actually run/opened.

files.dist/military_calisthenics_coach_v5.html: THE APP — single self-contained offline file (built; do not hand-edit, edit src/ then build)
v4 baseline — MUST stay byte-identical (sha256 in original/SHA256SUMS)
files.src/index.html: HTML shell (header, logo SVG, nav container, dialogs); CSS/JS are injected by tools/build.mjs
files.src/styles.css: All UI styling; theme tokens in :root (dark) and :root[data-theme=light]; khaki/black/grey palette
files.src/fig.css: Styling of the animated exercise figures (SVG classes mc-*)
files.src/anim.js: MCAnim — 2D articulated figure engine (FK/IK, props incl. gym equipment, player, validation)
files.src/data/_core.js: MCEX registry + vocabularies (muscles, patterns, equipment, safety flags, universal stop signs)
files.src/data/ex_*.js: Exercise records with per-exercise animation keyframes (bodyweight + gym files ex_gym_*.js)
files.src/sources.js: MCSRC source register (status: seen-in-search / unverified / local)
files.src/store.js: MCStore — IDs, localStorage persistence, import/export validation, v4 migration, encryption, multi-user accounts
files.src/screening.js: MCScreen — bilingual health questions (SCR-5.1.0) and deterministic outcome rules
files.src/engine.js: MCEngine — bodyweight weekly plan rules (RULES-5.0.0), adaptation, review questions, safe overrides
files.src/gym.js: MCGym — weighted gym program (separate from bodyweight), double progression of load
files.src/goals.js: MCGoals — numeric goals (e.g. 60 push-ups in 2 min, target weight), tests, projections, ranks/achievements
files.src/ui_core.js: UI helpers, shell/render, trainees management, data/backup/accounts page, sources page
files.src/ui_setup.js: Simple one-page bilingual setup, home page, More page
files.src/ui_plan.js: Weekly plan view, safe change dialog, print/PDF layout, trainee reading copy (HTML)
files.src/ui_session.js: Live workout runner, post-workout check, weekly review, history
files.src/ui_library.js: Exercise library, animation player, rep counter, interval timer, audio cues
files.src/ui_screen.js: Detailed screening page, documented clearance, detailed baseline (under More)
files.src/main.js: Boot + global event delegation (data-act / data-form / change handlers)
files.tools/check.mjs: Validates every exercise record + animation geometry
files.tools/preview.mjs: Renders key poses to PNG contact sheets for visual review
files.tools/AUTHORING.md: How to add an exercise (fields, pose coordinates, gym props)
files.tools/ids.txt: Master exercise ID plan (OMITTED lines = drawings judged misleading)
files.tests/a11y.cjs: axe-core accessibility audit (needs axe-core path in AXE env)

storage.encryption: optional; v2 = multi-user accounts (random data key wrapped per user with PBKDF2-SHA256 310k → AES-GCM-256)
exportFormats: MCC-ENC v2 (full encrypted copy, opened with any listed account)
